rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fourteen builder trees go (ficus, corals and canary date palms along the back fences, four queen palms 3-4.2 m from the house fronts, a magnolia by the arbor); four come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the arbor, on the open lot corner, and two back yards.

trees.why: the back yard with the garden arbor (2.4 m off): a magnolia beside it
the open lot corner at the north-east, 25 m from the walls: an old ficus
the north back lot line, 12 m from the houses: a coral tree between two yards
the south-west back yard, 5.4 m from the house: the yard's tree
